description: This Java source file defines the EntityFindOptions class, which encapsulates various options for advanced entity finding operations in the OFBiz framework, including result set type, concurrency, fetch size, limits, and offsets.

classes.name: EntityFindOptions
classes.description: A class providing configurable options for entity find operations, such as result set type, concurrency, fetch size, limits, and distinct filtering.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing default find options.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
